source.definition: Official Board XML SLOOS dataset, SUBLPDCILS_N.Q (standards) and SUBLPDCILD_N.Q (demand). All domestic banks, large/middle-market borrowers; quarterly percentages. Exact BANKSIZE=ALL/PANEL=DOM/LOANTYPE=CILG/MEASURE=STND or DEMAND/TERMS=NA/FREQ=162/UNIT=Percentage/UNIT_MULT=1. Same published definitions as FRED DRTSCILM/DRSDCILM, but no FRED numeric data obtained or used. Not large-bank subgroup, loan terms, interest rate, weighted aggregate or purified credit supply shock.
source.availability: CONDITIONAL current-vintage screen: end of second month of quarter label, America/New_York. Jan label -> Feb month end, Apr -> May, Jul -> Aug, Oct -> Nov. source_date is this explicitly named proxy release date for unchanged TTL adapter, NOT an actual original release. Observation date retained separately. No availability from quarter label itself; no original vintage/revision guarantee.
source.date_mapping: XML TIME_PERIOD is quarterly period-end label, normalized to its quarter start before the frozen conditional availability rule. Both labels retained; neither is claimed to be publication. Selected33quarters2017Q4-2025Q4. Other series and outside-window cells are ignored before status/value inspection. Status A required; unexpected statuses fail closed.
source.rights: Board of Governors SLOOS direct official XML, public-domain Board data unless otherwise marked, attribution/notices preserved, private research/no raw redistribution. Official index and disclaimer captured/hash-verified. Separate FRED legal/CSV first attempts timed out, no FRED numeric data used.

signal.mechanism: Joint tightening of credit standards and weakening business loan demand may precede weaker investment/activity and oil demand. US survey is not global oil demand; supply shocks, policy response, sanctions and bank composition can overwhelm this link.
signal.primary: BR short0.9 iff DRTSCILM>0 AND DRSDCILM<0 in latest complete available quarter; otherwise cash. Exact Decimal comparison to economic zero. One rule, no fit/search.
signal.control: Constant BR short0.9 on identical readiness/calendar; diagnostic only, no post-outcome promotion.
signal.missing: Either dot/missing value masks newest state; no zero fill, interpolation or older-good fallback. Missing entire quarter, malformed/nonfinite/out-of-range percentage, duplicate date, wrong header or protected date fails closed. Genuine zero is neutral/cash but ready.

limitations: Economic hypothesis stated before full corpus states/targets/PnL. Earlier web snippets exposed selected2017/2025 survey values and old FRED data; source is not wholly unseen. Existing2018-2025 futures outcomes were seen in prior experiments, so this is development, not independent holdout.

Original PDF/HTML reconstruction paused after two route-format failures, preserved without V3. One actual2017 PDF cover confirms Nov6 publication of October survey, not Oct1 availability. FRED legal/firstCSV timed out; a separate one-request direct Board XML download succeeded. Conditional clock unchanged, not repair/proof of original timestamps or revisions.

One rule/asset over full2018-2025, zero natural sign boundaries, no favorable era/window/threshold/lag/TTL selected from new outcomes. Percentages reflect respondent shares, not credit amounts or causal CSI. All-bank population avoids explicit2023large-bank-cutoff subgroup splice but does not establish constant sample composition.

Unchanged V72/V78/V64 next-factual-open integer futures ledger and research specs/fees/margin. Cash interest0. Each of four cases must be execution-complete/critical0/unresolved0/terminalflat. Rolls counted separately from independent economic episodes; trip gate is not independence proof.

Five-percent Stage1 component gate does not redefine relatively predictable20-50percent active goal. Stage1 PASS if any is only a candidate for further examination, never profit/PIT/live proof. Source-only failures do not count as tested portfolio entrants.
